text:
maria: heads up — i'm rolling a tf change to move `search-api` from ALB TLS termination -> NLB passthrough for gRPC (customers requested end-to-end tls). quick sync?
ajay: thanks. is this the change in the PR you opened? #8423?
nate: yep that PR. main bits: svc -> type=LoadBalancer (nlb), annotations for passthrough, gateway secretbinding to pass cert, and bump nodePort range for canary nodes.
maria: exact annotations i'm adding: `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: nlb` and `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-backend-protocol: tcp` + `service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-ssl-ports: 443`. any other required keys for gRPC passthrough?
ajay: add `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` in the svc so source IP preserved for our trusted-ip ACL. also ensure targetPort is the container port (grpc 8080) and health check uses TCP/ssl passthrough otherwise ALB-style http probes will 502.
maria: noted. PR currently has `targetPort: 8080` and `port: 443`. health check in terraform LB config currently still http on /health. should we switch it to tcp?
nate: switch to TCP healthchecks. In our infra, NLB healthcheck TargetType should be IP and port 8080. If TargetType is instance + nodePort we get mismatches when using pod IPs.
sre-oncall: small caution: if you use `externalTrafficPolicy: Local` and there are no pods on a node, requests can drop. make sure pod distribution or pod anti-affinity updated for canary.
maria: good catch — adding podAntiAffinity and a podDisruptionBudget to the rollout plan.
infra-bot: terraform plan: module.nlb.aws_lb_target_group.main will change health_check { protocol: "HTTP" -> "TCP" } (1 to update)
ajay: confirm secret wiring plan — gateway-api secretbinding must reference the same cert object in the customer's namespace or our control plane namespace? We had earlier bugs where secretbinding was created in wrong ns.
maria: design is to create cert as a namespaced secret in `platform-tls` and SecretBinding in `gateway-system` pointing to that secret via `secretRef`. PR shows SecretBinding created in `gateway-system` referencing `platform-tls/search-api-cert`.
ajay: that should be fine as long as the Gateway has permission. We need RBAC: `gateway-system` service account needs `get` on secrets in `platform-tls`. have you added the ClusterRoleBinding?
maria: not yet — will add in the same PR. sample role patch: ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: gateway-secret-reader
  namespace: platform-tls
rules:
- apiGroups: ["" ]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
```
ajay: Role is namespaced; Gateway controller SA will be in `gateway-system`. You need a RoleBinding in `platform-tls` that subjects the `gateway-system` SA.
maria: right, will add RoleBinding.
nate: one more: when rotating certs we need to ensure SecretBinding reconciler picks up new secret names (we rotate by creating `search-api-cert-v2` then switch binding). plan for rollout: create v2, update SecretBinding -> Gateway, wait for green, delete v1.
sre-oncall: add a runbook step: if nlb health checks fail, fallback to ALB for the route via routing policy in the infra-app so we don't cause user impact.
maria: good. i'm going to run `terraform apply` in staging after adding RoleBinding + tcp healthcheck. will ping here when plan is applied.
infra-bot: terraform apply completed in staging (workspace: staging) — 1 to add, 3 to change, 0 to destroy.
maria: staging looks healthy. NLB tg health -> healthy on 3/3 targets, gateway shows TLS passthrough success.
ajay: can you share the minimal `kubectl` checks for SRE to verify?
maria: sure — run: ```bash
kubectl -n search get svc search-api -o yaml
kubectl -n gateway-system get secretbinding search-api-binding -o yaml
kubectl -n platform-tls get secret search-api-cert -o yaml
```
nate: also `kubectl -n gateway-system logs deployment/gateway-controller` to watch SecretBinding reconciliation.
maria: scheduling prod rollout tomorrow 09:00 UTC — i'll post a short RFC in #eng-oncall. tagging @sre-oncall for coverage.
sre-oncall: i'll be on shift, can monitor and revert routing if any tls errors. :thumbsup:
ajay: one last thing — update the terraform module docs about `nlb_passthrough` flag and healthcheck protocol so future teams don't repeat this.
maria: will update module README in the PR. thanks all!
